description:
The village of Hoori lies deep in the middle of the mountains, inaccessible by rail. Since there isn’t much interaction with its surroundings, the town seems like it is stuck in the past. However, it is because of this exact olden feel and subsequent development that it has turned into a nice hot-springs town for tourists.

One of the popular sightseeing spots is the legendary katana Murasamemaru, embedded in stone. No one has been able to pull it out… until Masaomi somehow broke it in half. He has to take responsibility for his actions: “Marriage” with ‘shrine maiden princess’ Yoshino!? He was perplexed at the unexpected turn of events, but this is only just the beginning. What lies ahead for him is a much more peculiar and mysterious life, including his new fiancée, a mysterious girl who only he could touch, and the secret behind the curse that remains on the town.

What will become of Masaomi’s love amidst his rapidly changing life? The answer lies within the Murasamemaru in his hands.

(Source: VNDB)

A group of ordinary people from all walks of life suddenly find themselves in the "Land of Finality." Here, they are trapped in a ten-day cycle of life and death, with their memories wiped clean after every reset. To escape, they must constantly wager their lives in deadly trials hosted by the "Twelve Zodiacs," engaging in psychological warfare and battling both the hosts and their fellow players with strength and wits.
Trapped within this nightmare, Qi Xia is driven by a single obsession: to return to reality and save his wife from imminent danger. As the ten-day cycles repeat, a supernatural power known as "Echo" begins to awaken within certain players. Slowly, Qi Xia and his companions start recovering their sealed memories, uncovering the perilous truth behind this bizarre world and their intertwined fate with the Land of Finality.
Armed with his unparalleled intellect and the diverse "Echo" abilities of his allies, Qi Xia leads his companions to defeat the enemies of the Land of Finality and carve a path back home.

A scientific expedition from Blue Star discovered a strange humanoid corpse exposed in a vacuum on the planet Minglong. The expedition brought it back to Blue Star for research, but unexpectedly, they also brought disaster. The energy emanating from the humanoid corpse caused the entire Blue Star biosphere to enter a state of supernatural evolution. Fortunately, the humans on Blue Star were also within the biosphere and entered the supernatural evolutionary sequence, successively evolving into: Human-level, Earth-level, and Celestial-level evolvers. The seven most powerful Celestial-level evolvers were known as the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​protecting Hanxia in this chaotic world fraught with calamities. The anomalies on Blue Star attracted the attention of the Great Yu Empire, which ruled this star field. The Great Yu Empire believed that these anomalies might be related to a fugitive they were hunting. Therefore, taking advantage of the emergence of the Tenth Academy of the Starry Sky, they issued an academy trial, attracting a large number of students from combat academies to Blue Star under the guise of trials to find the fugitive and hone their new blood. On Blue Star, a young man named Lu Yin lies in hiding. He is unaware of his identity and origins; his earliest memories are of a bloody massacre, leaving him alone and stranded on Blue Star. As Blue Star undergoes a dramatic transformation, he realizes this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. He needs a clean new identity to return to that dangerous starry sea and seek revenge for the blood debts of the past. Thus, Lu Yin, the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​students of the Great Yu Empire, and various other forces enter the scene. On Blue Star, an unprecedented evolution and hunt is about to begin.

After a decade of seclusion and arduous cultivation, he remained stuck at the Initial Realm, unable to make any progress. One day, a chance opportunity reactivated the system. He set out from the mountain with his younger sister, Lu Dongli, in search of spiritual herbs to break through his cultivation barrier. Along the way, he ingeniously solved a challenge posed by a strange beast, defied the heavens to summon nine Celestial Decrees to awaken his spiritual power, and broke through five cultivation realms in succession. He even faced down a challenge from a prodigy of the Sword Sect. The once-useless sect master thus began a powerful comeback.

He traverses the Heavenly Demon Treasury, the Dragon Transformation Realm, and ancient ruins, acquiring supreme treasures such as the Demon Lord Armor and the Great Desolate Mirror. Various prodigies, sect parasites, and extraterrestrial evil races come to his death, but he crushes them all with a single sword strike! He subdues a dragon soul and a spirit dog, protects his beloved friends and family, surpasses Martial Kings, breaks through Martial Emperors, and ascends to Martial Venerable status. Armageddon—the final war between good and evil, to be waged at the end of the world. Its predetermined outcome was overturned. The desperate wish of those who “did not want to die”—that hopeless selfishness—empowered the evil god. Eight billion humans were sacrificed, and only a handful were allowed to survive—to be toyed with endlessly as the evil god’s playthings. The “Frashokereti” (Renewal of the World), which had been repeated countless times since the dawn of the universe, was shattered here for the first time.

The sun will never rise again.
In a world where reason has gone mad, there is only one thing of value: human blood.
Blood is currency. Blood is fuel. Blood is—a weapon.

After countless sacrifices, the magicians devised a single spell. A forbidden ritual that transforms a girl’s blood into a blade capable of vanquishing demons.
Blood as a weapon. Life as a weapon. Humanity itself—the final weapon to resist the demons.
Chosen… Survivors… The strongest, cursed girls.
Blood-battle humans—.

The younger sister is the strongest blood-battle human, her soul stolen. The older sister was born unable to walk. Yet, she is the only one in this world—her blood alone can awaken the power of her slumbering sister.

Eva and Epica. Sisters bound by fate in the darkness of the apocalypse.
With their blood... strike down the demons that have defiled the world!

An original dark fantasy action series by Seiji Kishi, Makoto Uezu, LAM, and Polygon Pictures is here!
